subsets.all_test: all rows in each strict-split held-out test partition
subsets.thermo_positive: rows with y_thermo=1, verified equivalent to E_hull<=0.10 eV/atom

ensemble_threshold_rule: Maximum-MCC threshold fitted once on the corresponding five-seed mean validation probability, then frozen for held-out test evaluation

bootstrap.method: paired material-level percentile bootstrap on five-seed mean held-out test probabilities
